SELECT aa.* FROM ( SELECT a.pdSeq ,a.pdName ,a.pdUseNy ,a.pdOrder ,a.pdDesc ,a.pdDelNy ,a.pdPrice ,a.pdPriceDcRate ,a.pdfavorite ,a.pdMedia ,a.pdTerm ,a.pdReview ,a.regDateTime ,a.modDateTime ,b.memberSeq ,b.memberName ,(SELECT COUNT(b.memberSeq) FROM member b WHERE 1=1 AND a.member_memberSeq = b.memberSeq) AS xproductSeqCount
ORDER BY a.pdSeq DESC ) aa limit #{rowNumToShow} offset #{startRnumForMysql}

SELECT a.pdName ,a.pdUseNy ,a.pdOrder ,a.pdDesc ,a.pdDelNy ,a.pdPrice ,a.pdPriceDcRate ,a.pdFavorite ,a.pdMedia ,a.pdTerm ,a.pdReview ,a.pdRating ,a.regDateTime ,a.modDateTime ,a.member_memberSeq FROM product a WHERE 1=1 AND a.pdSeq = #{pdSeq}
SELECT * FROM pdReview a LEFT JOIN member c ON a.member_memberSeq = c.memberSeq where a.product_pdSeq = #{pdSeq}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pdReview a LEFT JOIN product b ON a.product_pdSeq = b.pdSeq LEFT JOIN member c ON a.member_memberSeq = c.memberSeq where a.product_pdSeq = #{pdSeq}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product WHERE 1=1 AND pdSeq = #{pdSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET pdDelNy = 1 WHERE 1=1 AND pdSeq = #{pdSeq}
